newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to target 130.00 as bulls hold sway.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to target 130.00 as bulls hold sway.

text.p: June BTP futures on LIFFE look set to push higher on Friday, targeting 130.00 on the back of stronger Treasuries and Bunds, technical analysts said.
"Technically the market looks very bullish and our next target is 130.00 if Bunds stay above 102.00," said one analyst at a European bank.
"BTPs are looking very strong on the back of the U.S. T-bonds following Greenspan's remarks on the U.S. economy."
By 0758 GMT, June BTPs were at 129.60, up 0.62 from the prior close. June Bunds were up 0.28 at 101.99.

U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan said on Thursday he expected U.S economic growth to slow later this year and into the next. His comments gave T-bonds a boost and helped lend a favourable tone to European bond markets, dealers said.
The analyst pegged support for BTPs at around 128.90 and initial resistance around 129.80 with 130.20 above that.

Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, said in a note to clients that the week's corrections had proved to be short-lived as BTPs surged through previous resistance at 129.05.
"We stay on the bull track continuing to use pullbacks now under the figure as a further buying opportunity ahead of the uptrend to our objectives at 130.00," he said.
Adcock placed stops under 128.26, saying only breaks of this level would abort the market's bullish potential.
The June Eurolire contract was also driven higher, trading at 93.29, up 0.05.
